dress_and_conduct: Dress modestly in town and villages; no transparent clothing or bikinis in town; bikinis are for the beach.
Greet people, speak quietly in villages and ask before taking photos or video, especially of children; you may otherwise be asked for money.
sacred_or_restricted_places: Village and beach land is often customary: ask permission before entering a yard, beach or ceremonial space and pay any custom fee asked.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Families and village communities under kastom.
culture-and-protocol.note: National guidance from the Vanuatu Tourism Office applied to this province.

laws.rule: Ambrym volcanoes (Benbow and Marum): hiring accredited local guides (certified by the Department of Tourism, licensed and first-aid trained) is highly recommended; avoid the rainy season, when unmaintained trails become impassable.
